lineWeightFloorRevision.criterion: Every valid main-outline median sensitivity ratio is >= 1.0; at least two valid thresholds including 36. This is a raster estimate, not pixel-identical tracing.

losslessEncodingRevision.method: PNG lossless encoding search; oxipng level 6 and Zopfli 30 iterations; no alpha optimization
losslessEncodingRevision.note: Latest encoded file hashes are weapons[].sha256. Historical drawing revision hashes remain immutable; decoded pixels, import metadata and runtime geometry are unchanged.
